cards.ex: This report is hot off the press, so the data is very current.
cards.exUz: Bu hisobot yangi chop etilgan, shuning uchun ma'lumotlar juda dolzarb.
cards.uzDef: Faqatgina chop etilgan, eng so'nggi yangilik yoki ma'lumot.

cards.ex: The newspaper should not give a platform to hate speech.
cards.exUz: Gazeta nafrat nutqiga platforma bermasligi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishiga o'z fikrlarini keng auditoriyaga yetkazish imkoniyatini berish.

cards.ex: Let's do a deep dive into the implications of this new policy.
cards.exUz: Keling, ushbu yangi siyosatning oqibatlarini chuqur o'rganamiz.
cards.uzDef: Mavzuni chuqur va batafsil o'rganish.

cards.ex: The article paints a vivid picture of life in the refugee camp.
cards.exUz: Maqola qochqinlar lageridagi hayotning yorqin tasvirini yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: So'zlar bilan biror narsaning aniq tasvirini yaratish.

cards.ex: The trial sparked a media frenzy that lasted for weeks.
cards.exUz: Sud jarayoni bir necha hafta davom etgan ommaviy axborot vositalarining shiddatiga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy axborot vositalarining biror voqeaga haddan tashqari e'tibor qaratishi.

cards.ex: The news broke late last night that the CEO had resigned.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor iste'foga chiqqani haqidagi yangilik kecha kechqurun tarqaldi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ma'lumotlar yoki voqea ma'lum bo'lib qoldi.

cards.ex: Both sides are trying to shape the narrative around the election results.
cards.exUz: Ikkala tomon ham saylov natijalari atrofidagi hikoyani shakllantirishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Voqea yoki hodisaning qanday qabul qilinishini o'zgartirishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The reporter cited a credible source within the government.
cards.exUz: Muxbir hukumat ichidagi ishonchli manbaga asoslandi.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchga loyiq bo'lgan, haqiqiy ma'lumot beruvchi manba.

cards.ex: Always double-check your facts before publishing an article.
cards.exUz: Maqola chop etishdan oldin har doim faktlarni qayta tekshiring.
cards.uzDef: Xatoliklarni oldini olish uchun ma'lumotni yana bir bor tekshirish.

cards.ex: You have to take what he says with a grain of salt; he exaggerates.
cards.exUz: Uning gaplariga shubha bilan qarashingiz kerak; u mubolag'a qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga to'liq ishonmaslik, shubha bilan qarash.

cards.ex: The story was covered coast to coast after the scandal broke.
cards.exUz: Janjal boshlanganidan so'ng, bu hikoya butun mamlakat bo'ylab yoritildi.
cards.uzDef: Bir mamlakatning bir qirg'og'idan ikkinchisigacha bo'lgan butun hudud.

cards.ex: The article had an eye-catching headline that drew me in.
cards.exUz: Maqolaning diqqatni tortuvchi sarlavhasi meni jalb qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'quvchilarning e'tiborini jalb qiladigan sarlavha.

cards.ex: Politicians live their lives in the public eye.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchilar o'z hayotlarini ommaning nigohida yashaydilar.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning e'tibori va kuzatuvi ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: The journalist is determined to get to the bottom of the corruption scandal.
cards.exUz: Jurnalist korrupsiya janjalining tubiga yetishga qaror qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning haqiqiy sababini aniqlash.

cards.ex: The reviews for the new show have been a mixed bag.
cards.exUz: Yangi shou uchun sharhlar aralash holatda bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil yaxshi va yomon elementlardan iborat narsa.

cards.ex: It's a race against time to find the missing hikers.
cards.exUz: Yo'qolgan sayohatchilarni topish vaqtga qarshi kurashdir.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt tugashidan oldin biror narsani qilishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The activists are calling out the company for its environmental practices.
cards.exUz: Faollar kompaniyani ekologik amaliyotlari uchun fosh qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Xatoni yoki noto'g'ri xatti-harakatni ochiqchasiga tanqid qilish.

cards.ex: The politicians are engaged in a war of words over the new law.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchilar yangi qonun ustida og'zaki urush olib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy bahs yoki nizolar seriyasi.

cards.ex: The government's new policy is drawing criticism from all sides.
cards.exUz: Hukumatning yangi siyosati hamma tomondan tanqidga sabab bo'lmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tanqidga uchraydigan xatti-harakatlar yoki qarorlar qilish.

cards.ex: The reporters managed to dig up some interesting information about the company's past.
cards.exUz: Muxbirlar kompaniyaning o'tmishi haqida qiziqarli ma'lumotlarni qazib olishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani izlab topish, odatda qiyinchilik bilan.

cards.ex: A lot of negotiations happened behind the scenes before the deal was finalized.
cards.exUz: Kelishuv yakunlanishidan oldin sahna ortida ko'plab muzokaralar bo'lib o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Omma ko'rmaydigan, yashirin tarzda amalga oshiriladigan ishlar.

cards.ex: Investigating the scandal could open a real can of worms.
cards.exUz: Janjalni tekshirish haqiqiy muammolar tugunini ochishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yechish juda qiyin bo'lgan muammolar to'plami.

cards.ex: Make sure you get your facts straight before you publish that story.
cards.exUz: Ushbu hikoyani chop etishdan oldin faktlarni aniqlashtiring.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri ma'lumotga ega bo'lish, xato qilmaslik.

cards.ex: The newspaper jumped the gun and published the story before it was confirmed.
cards.exUz: Gazeta shoshilib, hikoyani tasdiqlanmasdan nashr etdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtidan oldin biror narsa qilishga shoshilish.

cards.ex: The journalist got a real scoop on the celebrity scandal.
cards.exUz: Журналист машҳурлар жанжали ҳақида ҳақиқий сенсацияга эга бўлди.
cards.uzDef: Энг сўнгги ва муҳим янгилик.

cards.ex: The official spoke on background, without being named.
cards.exUz: Расмий шахс исмини ошкор этмаслик шарти билан гапирди.
cards.uzDef: Ахборот манбасини ошкор этмаслик шарти билан.

cards.ex: The company is currently under investigation for fraud.
cards.exUz: Компания ҳозирда фирибгарлик бўйича тергов остида.
cards.uzDef: Бирор ҳолат ёки шахснинг тергов қилинаётгани.

cards.ex: The event received extensive media coverage.
cards.exUz: Воқеа кенг ОАВ ёритилишига сазовор бўлди.
cards.uzDef: Воқеа ёки мавзунинг ОАВ томонидан ёритилиши.

cards.ex: The politician is now in damage limitation mode after the scandal.
cards.exUz: Сиёсатчи жанжалдан кейин зарарни чеклаш режимида.
cards.uzDef: Зарарни камайтиришга қаратилган чоралар.

cards.ex: The article was accused of stoking fears about immigration.
cards.exUz: Мақола иммиграция ҳақида қўрқувни кучайтиришда айбланди.
cards.uzDef: Одамларда қўрқув ҳиссини уйғотиш ёки кучайтириш.
